name: Fallen angel
idea: Within one session that opened above the previous close: a rise to a new session high, a sharp fall, then a tight base; the signal is the first close above the base, on volume against the base's bars. The idea is wrong below the base.

params.label: Open above the previous close (%)
params.help: The session opened at least this many percent above the previous close (below it for the downside); 0 means not set: any open at or above it.

params.label: Fall from the session high
params.help: The fall from the session high to the base's low, at least this many average true ranges (the rise from the session low for the downside; 0 means not set).

params.label: Base (bars)
params.help: The bars of the base just before the signal bar, all in this session.

params.label: Largest base range
params.help: The base's high to low, at most this many average true ranges (a tight base).

params.label: Volume against the base
params.help: The signal bar's volume, at least this many times the largest volume of the base's bars (0 means no volume condition).

params.label: ATR period
params.help: The bars of the average true range the distances and buffers are measured in.

params.label: Buffer
params.help: How many average true ranges beyond the base's low (0 means not set: the base's low itself).

params.label: A new low against (bars)
params.help: For the template's exit signal: a close beyond the low (high for the downside) of this many bars before it.

setup.long: SessionCount(true) > $base_n AND (DayOpen() - PDC()) / PDC() * 100 >= $gap_pct AND (SessionHigh() - Min(low, $base_n)[1]) >= $drop_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND (Max(high, $base_n)[1] - Min(low, $base_n)[1]) <= $base_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1]
setup.short: SessionCount(true) > $base_n AND (PDC() - DayOpen()) / PDC() * 100 >= $gap_pct AND (Max(high, $base_n)[1] - SessionLow()) >= $drop_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND (Max(high, $base_n)[1] - Min(low, $base_n)[1]) <= $base_atr * ATR($atr_n)[1]
